name: Views
description: No-code saved queries over document collections: a visual filter/sort/column builder with OR-logic groups, a public JSON/CSV API, persistent table/cards displays, chromeless public embeds with share tokens, and KV-cached reads.
author: Mark McIntosh

_howto.title: Pick a collection
_howto.body: Go to Views > New View and choose the collection this view will query. The collection can't be changed after the view is created — start a new one if you pick wrong.

_howto.title: Build your filters
_howto.body: Add a condition: field, comparison (equals, contains, starts with, is between, is one of, is empty, greater/less than), and a value. The live preview on the right updates as you type. Need OR instead of AND? Add a condition group.

_howto.title: Choose columns and sort
_howto.body: Pick which fields the view returns — leave everything unchecked to return all fields. Add a sort order; multiple sorts apply in the order you add them.

_howto.title: Save it
_howto.body: Create View turns this into a live GET /api/views/:name endpoint. It's admin-only by default — nothing is exposed publicly yet.

_howto.title: Go public (optional)
_howto.body: Check Public API on the view to let anyone read its published rows over HTTP — only works if the underlying collection also allows public read.

_howto.title: Publish an embed (optional)
_howto.body: Open the view's Display page, pick which columns to show, and hit Publish. You get a chromeless page at /v/:path, or an unlisted share link that works without making the view public.

_routes.description: Public JSON/CSV endpoint for a view. Only serves published rows from views marked Public API, on a collection that also grants public read. Supports ?page, ?limit, ?filter[field][_op]=value, ?sort, and ?format=csv.
Public, chromeless page for a published display — no admin UI, just the table/cards rendering of that view's rows.
Admin builder — create a view, filter/sort/columns, live preview, and publish/share a display.
